name: Mail Apps
description: Read and send Joinery mail from a desktop or phone mail program (Thunderbird, Apple Mail, any IMAP and SMTP client) with an app password. Standard and Private mailboxes; Private ones while the vault is unlocked on the website.
author: Joinery

settings.name: mail_apps_enabled
settings.helptext: Written by the Allow mail apps switch on the Mail apps admin page, which also turns the mail gateway on or off and ends borrowed unlocks. Never set it anywhere else: the gateway and the windows would not follow.

settings.name: mail_apps_served_name
settings.helptext: The mail host name the gateway was turned on with, recorded by the Allow mail apps switch. What the Mail apps page and autoconfig tell programs to connect to while mail apps are on.

settings.name: mail_apps_route
settings.helptext: How mail programs reach this site, recorded with mail_apps_served_name by the Allow mail apps switch: direct, or relay (through this deployment's own relay). Kept until the admin presses Switch, or until the route can no longer work (KeepMailAppsReachable).

settings.name: mail_apps_container_name
settings.helptext: In a container only: the name mail programs connect to when it is not the site's web name (a web name behind Cloudflare carries no mail ports). A name under the web name, pointing straight at the site's server. Set on the Mail apps admin page; empty means the web name.

settings.name: mail_apps_route_notice
settings.helptext: The last change KeepMailAppsReachable made without the admin (a relay that is gone), as time|text. Shown on the Mail apps admin page until dismissed.
